svg.aria-label: on the left, three control points on the corner of a square: with all weights one the curve bulges outside the quarter circle, with the middle weight root two over two it is the quarter circle; on the right, one triangle with the middle weight zero, 0.4, one and three, giving a chord, an ellipse, a parabola and a hyperbola
svg.text: ONE TRIANGLE, THE MIDDLE WEIGHT VARIED
